features.apple: Localizable: Degrees, Radians, Rad
features.note: Persisted in settings (history.rs:120).

features.apple: Localizable: Add to Memory, Subtract from Memory, Recall Memory, Clear Memory
Localizable: Open/Close Parenthesis

features.feature: Programmer mode (hex/dec/oct/bin bases, bitwise AND/OR/XOR/NOR/NOT, shifts, rotate, byte/word flip, 2's complement, binary view, ASCII/Unicode display)
features.apple: Localizable: Programmer, Hexadecimal, Bitwise …, Shift Left/Right, Rotate, Byte Flip, Word Flip, Show Binary, ASCII value, Unicode value
features.note: Paste accepts 0x/0b/0o (paste.rs) but there is no programmer keypad.
features.wire: Add a "Programmer" segment in the toolbar (calc.rs:396) and a new programmer.rs: u64 value with base (2/8/10/16), keypad A-F, AND/OR/XOR/NOR/NOT, <<, >>, shift by y, rotate, byte flip, word flip, negate; a clickable 64-bit binary row; ASCII/Unicode readout. Wire keyboard keys for and, or, xor, not and shifts in main.rs:78.

features.feature: RPN mode (enter, drop, swap, roll up/down, stack display)
features.apple: Localizable: RPN Mode On/Off, Enter, Drop, Swap, Rotate stack up/down
features.note: No RPN.
features.wire: Add an RPN flag in Settings (history.rs:106) with a View-menu toggle; rpn.rs stack (Vec<f64>) where operators pop two; keypad replaces = with enter; keys cmd+E swap, cmd+Delete drop, cmd+Up/Down roll.

features.apple: Localizable: Unit Conversion, Category, Input Unit, Result Unit, Swap Units, Recent Units, Search all units
features.note: Five categories (length, mass, temperature, speed, volume) with swap; reference has many more categories, recent units and a unit search.
features.wire: Add area, time, data size, energy, pressure, power, angle, fuel in convert.rs; add a search field over all units and a recent-units list stored in settings.

features.apple: Localizable: Currency rates unavailable, rate source credit, Updated %@
features.note: No currency category.
features.wire: Add a Currency category in convert.rs fed by a rates service (titan or cloud endpoint) cached with an "Updated" timestamp; show the unavailable state offline.

features.feature: History sidebar (show/hide, grouped by day, delete one, clear all with confirm)
features.apple: Localizable: History, Show/Hide History, Today/Yesterday/Previous 7/30 Days, Delete, Clear History confirm
features.note: Sidebar with list, Copy Tape and Clear History; no day groups, no per-entry delete, no confirm before clearing.
features.wire: In the history pane draw section headers by date from Entry time (history.rs:14), add a per-row delete (context or swipe), and ask for confirmation in the Clear History handler (calc.rs:611).

features.apple: History list rows (tap to reuse result)
features.note: Tapping a row recalls its result into the display.
